description: The ICUSTAYS table provides information on individual Intensive Care Unit (ICU) stays for patients. It links patient identifiers (SUBJECT_ID, HADM_ID) to specific ICU stay identifiers (ICUSTAY_ID) and records details such as the database source, first and last care units, ward IDs, admission and discharge timestamps (INTIME, OUTTIME), and the length of stay (LOS) in days. This table allows for analysis of patient movement and duration of stay within the ICU.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the dataset.

columns.name: HADM_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the patient's hospital admission.

columns.name: ICUSTAY_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the patient's ICU stay.

columns.name: DBSOURCE
columns.description: The database source where the data was obtained, e.g., 'metavision'.

columns.name: FIRST_CAREUNIT
columns.description: The first ICU care unit the patient was admitted to, e.g., 'NICU', 'CCU'.

columns.name: LAST_CAREUNIT
columns.description: The last ICU care unit the patient was in during their stay, e.g., 'MICU', 'SICU'.

columns.name: FIRST_WARDID
columns.description: The ward ID of the patient upon admission to the ICU.

columns.name: LAST_WARDID
columns.description: The ward ID of the patient at discharge from the ICU.

columns.name: INTIME
columns.description: Timestamp when the patient was admitted to the ICU.

columns.name: OUTTIME
columns.description: Timestamp when the patient was discharged from the ICU.

columns.name: LOS
columns.description: Length of stay in the ICU, in days.
